Overview

Włocławek is a city in Kuyavian-Pomeranian with a population of 109,347. A historic city on the Vistula River, known for its ceramics industry, Gothic cathedral, and the Włocławek Dam hydroelectric plant. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
